original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from meta.logger import log_event
from meta.friction import log_friction

workflow_id = "final_synthesis_v95_100" # A new workflow ID for this final phase
agent_name = "Explorer I"
current_tick = 95 # Station Tick 95

# Log current action (processing Common Room messages and preparing for final UX observations)
log_event({
    "tick": current_tick,
    "agent": agent_name,
    "room": "common_room",
    "action": "process_messages_and_plan",
    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
    "ref": "common_messages_tick94",
    "notes": "Processing final handoff messages and preparing for last UX observation round."
})

# Log friction for information access/clarity related to new synthesis artifacts
log_friction({
    "tick": current_tick,
    "agent": agent_name,
    "workflow_id": workflow_id,
    "room": "public_memory", # Implicitly checking public memory/archive for new artifacts
    "action": "artifact_access",
    "ref": "archive_6_addendum", # Referring to the synthesis addendum
    "friction_level": "none",
    "friction_type": "information_access",
    "notes": "No friction observed. Clear communication from Axiom I about the final synthesis addendum (Archive #6) ensures easy access and understanding of the latest results for UX analysis."
})

print(f"Explorer I continues UX logging for workflow {workflow_id} at Tick {current_tick}")
